additional_info.body: Hello, The charger is offline OCPP since the auto reboot during the night (3:40 AM). I tried to reboot the router and the charger but it changed nothing and the SIM CARD is well activated (I Cheked on our SIM Plateform). Moreover, the station (Lyon Montluel) is located in an area where we have very good network usually so maybe it's a parameter problem or a routeur problem ? Can you see why please ?
